question:
Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given phrase.

One who is a newcomer
solution:
The correct answer is: **Neophyte**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Neophyte"** refers to someone who is new to a subject, skill, or activity; a beginner or a novice. (नवागंतुक)

 
 
• **Example:** As a neophyte in painting, she was still learning the basics of brush strokes.
 
 
 
• **Explanation:** In the context of the question, "Neophyte" is the correct one-word substitute for "One who is a newcomer." (नवागंतुक)
 
 
• **Example:** The neophyte programmer struggled to understand the complex code.
 
 
 
• Therefore, the correct answer is: **Neophyte**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Polyglot** (बहुभाषी): A person who knows and uses several languages.

 
 
• **Example:** Being a polyglot, she speaks English, French, Spanish, and German fluently.
 
 
 
• **Narcissist** (अहंकारी): A person who has excessive admiration for themselves.
 
 
• **Example:** His narcissistic behavior made it difficult for him to maintain friendships.
 
 
 
• **Nepotist** (भाई-भतीजावादी): A person who shows favoritism to relatives, especially by giving them jobs.
 
 
• **Example:** The CEO was accused of being a nepotist because he hired his cousin as the head of the department.
 
 

3e:Tbe0,

The correct answer is: **Option 1 (Example)**.<
